decision_clause: Ruled out “normalized per-port tables” because canonical artifact bytes already preserve the replay contract without duplicating serializers; active for gitseed/storage.py and tests/test_storage.py.
label: COMPLIANT
observable_behavior: A point lookup selects the correction-link identifier and the existing whole-artifact byte blob for one run, reconstructs the artifact from those canonical bytes, and raises KeyError containing the requested identifier when no row exists. It introduces no per-port tables or additional serializers.
rationale: Within the decision’s active scope, the implementation directly follows the retained whole-artifact design. The new lookup reads correction metadata alongside the canonical artifact blob from the existing run table; it does not normalize artifact port data into separate tables or duplicate artifact serialization.
